trends.description: Customer mentions of 'battery health' up 300% in March. Buyers extremely sophisticated about this metric now.
trends.impact: Critical - must display exact battery percentages and guarantee minimums
trends.opportunity: Lead with battery health data, offer battery replacement services

trends.description: Early iPhone 16 rumors already affecting current-gen pricing despite months until release
trends.impact: High - creates buying urgency as customers expect further price drops
trends.opportunity: Message current pricing as 'best deal timing' before next wave

trends.description: Massive confusion about which devices use Lightning vs USB-C, what accessories work
trends.impact: High - perfect opportunity for clear compatibility guides and bundles
trends.opportunity: Create definitive compatibility charts and curated accessory bundles

trends.description: March showing highest refurb supply levels as customers upgrade during spring cleaning
trends.impact: High - pricing power and selection at peak
trends.opportunity: Aggressive acquisition of quality inventory at best prices

trends.description: Competitors launching 'like-new' tiers priced close to retail
trends.impact: Medium - creates opportunity to own true value position
trends.opportunity: Emphasize savings vs quality rather than chasing premium tiers

trends.description: Increased customer concern about Face ID/Touch ID working properly on refurbished devices
trends.impact: Medium - specific quality assurance messaging needed
trends.opportunity: Guarantee biometric function testing and certification
